state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 4 (Syntax) is closed. `bun nv site --check syntax` passes, and `syntax/index.mdx` links the first page of every group. Stage 5 (Install and Guides) is next.**

Syntax has these groups, in sidebar order: Basics, Values and types, Operators, Control flow, Errors, Functions, Classes and objects, Programs and files, Concurrency, Attributes (4 pages) and Testing (2 pages). Snippets are under `website/snippets/syntax/<dir>/`. They are run with `nvs run`, so a `#[Test]` file prints nothing: its `.out` is empty, and the page shows the `nvs test` report as a `txt` block, copied from a real run.

`site structure`, `stale`, `reference` and `syntax` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `install/*`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stages 5 and 6 rewrite. `guides`, `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` (`LATER`, line 66) that fail until their stage writes them.
